scope: Fresh source review and isolated actual browser-module control flow at asynchronous/reentrant profile and preference boundaries. No live requests, accounts, payments, external provider access or browser/device execution.

findings.trigger: A second notification is queued. Another tab mutes speech, enables all-day quiet, disables that event or removes its preference record; the storage event has not arrived when the first utterance ends.
findings.baseline_observed: The second phrase still speaks for mute, because drain() checks in-memory values only.
findings.fixed_behavior: drain() rereads current profile and persisted preference state before use; missing/invalid records reset to safe defaults while preserving explicitly pending session changes.
findings.impact_limit: No bypass of server data access or real financial operation was demonstrated.

findings.trigger: The local profile changes while a previous profile notification queue awaits utterance completion, or during a personalization decorator callback.
findings.baseline_observed: The next prior-profile phrase speaks; no fresh scope check occurs at the use boundary.
findings.fixed_behavior: Profile/generation/ownership is checked before queue use and again after the external decorator; a changed profile clears the old queue.

findings.trigger: An Alice preferences panel or parsed voice settings request remains after switching the local scope to Bob.
findings.baseline_observed: The old control enables Bob speech because setPreference first switches scope and then applies the old control value.
findings.fixed_behavior: Rendered panels and parsed preference requests bind their owner. Stale/detached panels cannot change the current owner; stale panels are disabled with an explicit reopen message.
findings.impact_limit: This is an isolated local-profile contract; it does not establish a remote authenticated account exploit.

findings.trigger: A neural search proposal was prepared for Alice; the ordinary parser discovers the Bob profile and synchronously cancels the controller during Apply.
findings.baseline_observed: Actual local-ai.js and assistant-personalization.js terminate the worker and clear the query, but Apply continues and executes the old Alice search anyway.
findings.fixed_behavior: Apply refreshes actual personalization scope, then checks proposal identity, epoch, visibility and reviewed query again after the parser callback. Cancelled/stale actions do not execute.
findings.impact_limit: Only allowlisted navigation/search was reachable. No model financial commit or arbitrary code execution was demonstrated.

findings.trigger: A new dialog becomes top while a previous local-AI proposal callback remains queued, including a parser callback opening another dialog.
findings.baseline_observed: Without the top-dialog guard, the captured old Apply callback still executes its route/search through the new window.
findings.fixed_behavior: Apply requires the local-AI dialog to be the lifecycle top dialog before and after parsing; the new upper window stays open.
findings.impact_limit: Tests exercise retained callbacks and real module flow in a DOM model; no claim that native browser inert dialogs permit ordinary pointer clicks.

baseline_differential.expected_first_failure: mute must stop the already queued second phrase before storage delivery

verification.whole_release_suite: Performed by the parent on its final integrated snapshot; not claimed by this report.

preserved: Workspace raw-byte memoization and no disabled-notification inventory scan
Opt-in/quiet hours, bounded queue and event deduplication
Session-only preference choices after a failed durable write
Current freshly rendered controls and current confirmed safe search remain functional
Model integrity/URL policy, monetary restrictions and canonical bid confirmation unchanged
limitations: Node/DOM models, not physical Safari or actual browser speech scheduling.
Synthetic local profile IDs and local storage were used; no real user data.
No new shared real auction backend, authentication or money system was connected.
This bounded review does not prove absence of all vulnerabilities.

top_dialog_negative_probe.method: Remove only top()===dialog from a temporary copy of the otherwise fixed controller; run the unchanged new regression file.
top_dialog_negative_probe.expected_failure: a queued old Apply callback cannot navigate through another top dialog

peer_review: An independent performance agent reviewed the prefs/local-AI cancellation and ownership diffs; no new blocker identified. The large workspace raw cache remains intact.
